title: AI builder with a PhD in sustainable housing brings sustainability expertise to Brickanta
summary: Read the latest articles and updates from the Brickanta team.
body_markdown:
#### Press Release


*Max Rosvall Välme joins Brickanta, the agentic AI operating system for society builders. He brings a PhD in sustainable housing and two AI tools built for the construction industry, helping implement research grounded expertise directly into the platform.*


Brickanta, backed by leading tech, construction and AI investors like Northzone and Y Combinator, today announces that Rosvall Välme has joined the company. This is Brickanta's third acquihire, following the acquisitions of[Praxiom](https://brickanta.com/blog/brickanta-s-first-acquihire-a-construction-lawyer-s-self-built-ai-tool-joins-the-agentic-operating-system-for-construction) , the agentic construction-law tool built by lawyer Anne Wijkman, and[Alysa](https://brickanta.com/blog/brickanta-s-second-acquihire-kth-innovation-founded-ai-for-tendering-startup-alysa-and-its-ceo-and-co-founder) , the AI tendering tool co-founded by Nayar Grinberg.


Max built *Anbudsagenten* , a multi-agent system that writes tender text by matching a construction company's own generic documents against what a tender asks for. He followed it with *Klimatdeklaration Online* , a tool that helps real estate developers without in-house sustainability expertise produce an approved climate declaration.


The acquihire brings both the expertise in what sustainability in society building actually demands, and the tools to automate the tasks that otherwise take up time that builders and project managers should be spending on their actual work.


> " *What feels exciting about Brickanta is unlocking the potential that exists in generative AI and letting every role in construction focus on their core work, instead of repetitive tasks and workflows that can be digitized and automated. I look forward to being part of the team that builds the support for sustainable building — and an enabler for sustainable housing on a global scale.* "
>
>
> **Max Rosvall Välme, AI Engineer at Brickanta**


> *"Max spent his PhD studying what sustainable building actually requires, then went and built two tools that construction companies used and relied on. That combination of research depth and hands-on building is rare, and it's exactly what we need as we build out the sustainability side of the agentic AI platform."*
>
>
> **Lucas Otterling, CEO and co-founder of Brickanta**
